$comment: Identical to the version generated without the typed client, minus erasableSyntaxOnly.
openapi-generator's runtime uses TypeScript parameter properties, which that flag forbids,
and generated code is not ours to restyle. The flag only bans syntax a bundler has to strip,
which Vite does either way, so the cost is small and the alternative — a second TypeScript
project just for src/lib/api — is a build nobody would enjoy debugging.
